name: English
description: Casualty Psychology Full English Dialogue (Experiment/Milky/Dune), EN

psychology_frustration: Give me a break. Just one.
Why does nothing ever go right?
Are you kidding me right now?
I don't have time for this!
Why is it always like this?
Of course. Yep. Yeah. This might as well happen.
psychology_anger: Don't look at me like that.
I'm going to tear this whole place apart.
I will rip your throat out.
I'm about to lose my mind.
Get the hell out of my face.
Look at me again, I dare you.
I hate everything about this place.
psychology_fear: I don't want to die down here.
psychology_panic: I'm dying... I'm dying right now...
psychology_melancholy: I wish it would just end.
psychology_contentment: One foot in front of the other.
psychology_near_corpse_single: Oh god... is that a body?
Fuck me man... That's a bad sight.
No no no no. Oh god...
I hope I won't end up like this.
I knew there were more of us here...
It's gonna be okay... It's gonna be okay.
Someone should give them a proper burial.
God fucking damn it. Ugh. They're dead.
I thought I found someone for a second... Fuck...
How many of us have died here...? God... That's not a nice sight.
I better not end up like this.
Oh damn it. Fuck. I hate that...
I wish I could've given this guy a hug before they passed away.
I want to leave this place... Fuck...
I hope it wasn't painful, at least...
I'm scared I'll meet the same fate...
Oh fuck... That's one of our own... Ooohhh no...
psychology_near_corpse: I feel like it's staring at me...
psychology_corpse_desensitized: There really are a lot of us down here.
I think I'm getting used to the sight.
I've seen a lot of these by now.
This place is FILLED with corpses!
I wonder if I'll find someone living down here...
Not a good mortality rate in here.
Someone ought to arrange a funeral for 'em...
At least they're out of it.
psychology_near_animal_corpse: Whatever killed this might still be around.
At least it wasn't a person.
Poor creature didn't stand a chance.
Maybe there's still some good meat left on it..?
Bugs already picked at this one. Yeesh...
psychology_corpse_and_trap: Did the trap get him? Or was he already down?
...Laying right beside the jaws. Don't look at the teeth.
Step around the trap... don't look at it...
...He didn't see it. Just breathe... step around.
Don't look down at him. Just look where you're putting your boots.
...One trip and that's it. Keep it together.
Ugh... the smell. And a trap right beside him. God damn it.
Poor guy. Stepped right into it, didn't you...?
Yeah, pay better attention next time. Idiot.
Oh, that's REAL nice. I try to distract myself for FIVE fucking seconds...
psychology_near_corpse_aggressive: ...Get up. Come on, get up... damn it.
...Better not be whatever did this waiting around the corner.
psychology_near_corpse_stoic: ...Don't think about it. Just keep walking.
psychology_near_corpse_empathetic: Oh my... please don't let them have suffered.
I can't... I can't look at their face.
Poor guy. What a horrible way to go.
I'm sorry. I should've been there.
No, no no no no... Oh gosh...
I wish I could've saved you bud...
psychology_corpse_suicidal: I'll join you soon.
Not long until I end up like that.
I wish I was in their place.
Everything will end soon.
Maybe I wont be so miserable on the other side.
God, I want to be fucking dead too...
Being a corpse sounds very attractive right about now.
At least you managed to escape...
You've found your escape.
I don't blame you.
Any room for me...?
Yeah, fuck this place, buddy. I'll be with you soon enough.
I fucking hate this world.
I'll end up like this soon enough.
This brings me comfort. A reminder that it'll all end soon.
You got lucky.
I wish I was as lucky as you are.
I agree.
Yeah. This is a burden not worth carrying.
I can't wait for when I get the guts to end it.
I'm jealous.
I wish I had the courage to do what you did.
Sleep well, friend. Maybe I'll see you soon.
Heh... Maybe I'm the past tense version of you.
If only there was dust to bite on.
Damn, beat me to it.
Reviews say it ain't worth it down here, that's for sure.
psychology_corpse_and_trap_suicidal: Welp.. Guess I know what to do next.
I see what you did there.
Boy that looked painful... It's worth it though.
Can we get it over with already?...
psychology_near_trap: Don't want to get caught in that.
psychology_flashback_onset: T-this is like... Like when... No, no please-
psychology_flashback_coping: Look at the floor. Just stone. Just gray stone.
Breathe. One... two... three... four...
Touch your face. You're alive. You're here.
It's not real. It's not real.
You survived it. You're out.
Breathe through your teeth... calm down...
Focus on your hands. Just hands.
Get it out of your head. It's not real.
Make it stop please.
It's just a memory. Just a memory.
Focus on your feet. Just your feet.
You're fine, you're fine... just breathe.
It's not happening. It's not happening.
...Not there. Okay. You're okay.
F-four things you can see... Three things you can touch...
psychology_flashback_panic: GET IT! IT'S COMING FOR ME!
I can't do this again, I can't I can't Ican'tIcan'tIcan't-
PLEASE! I'M SORRY! I WON'T DO IT AGAIN!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
AAHHHH!!! I CAN'T DO THIS AGAIN!
I won't be bad anymore! Please! Just leave me alone!
Leave me alone, leave me alone, please...
psychology_flashback_fleeting: Just in my head. Keep moving.
Get a grip. It was nothing.
I saw a flash... it's... nevermind.
Huh?... just a trick of the light.
psychology_flashback_prolonged: Where am I?! It's happening again!
No, no, no... get out of my head!
Make it stop! Just make it stop!
I'm still there... I never left...
Wake up... damn it, wake up!
psychology_crisis_lashing: Stop looking at me like that!
I can't take this shit anymore!
Why does everything have to go to hell?!
I've had it UP TO HERE WITH THIS SHIT!
Oh, don't act like you know me! Fuck off!
Can you SHUT THE HELL UP?! GOD!
psychology_combo_melancholy_frustration: Just break then. See if I care.
Fuck this. Fuck all of this.
Another failure. Add it to the pile.
psychology_combo_depressive_success: Doesn't make me feel any better.
Ohhhh, look at me. I did a thing.
psychology_combo_euphoria_frustration: NO! Not now! I'm RIGHT HERE!
Ha! You think that stops me?!
I've got this! Don't you dare ruin this!
MAKE WAY! I CAN'T LOSE NOW!
COME ON! I know you're better than this!
psychology_combo_fear_anger: I'll take you down with me!
I'M NOT GOING DOWN WITHOUT A FIGHT!
psychology_combo_panic_melancholy: I can't... we're never getting out...
No point... but I'm so scared...
I don't want to die like this...
I can't... I can't do this anymore...
All of this... is too much...
psychology_combo_comfort_fear: It's a trap. It's gotta be.
Enjoy it while it lasts... won't be long.
This has to be a trick.
psychology_dissociation_numb: Not mine. None of this is mine.
I was... Um. I don't... I don't know...
It's all like... Glass. Everything's behind glass.
Since when did I look like this-?
Is this really what I sound like?
psychology_dissociation_breakdown: Oh God... oh God, I almost died back there.
My hands... they won't stop shaking...
What am I doing down here?! What is this place?!
I can't... I can't do this again...
It hurts... it all hurts so much now...
I was almost dead meat on the floor...
I can't... I can't fucking calm down!
What the fuck is going on down here!?
What the fuck?! Why did I do that?!
psychology_trio_doom: Nothing works, I'm freezing, and they're hunting us.
What a fucking joke this life is.
Why run anymore? There's nowhere to go.
I'm done for. Absolutely done for.
Laugh at me, I'm such a fucking comedian.
Yeah, it's over for me. Bye.
psychology_trio_berserk: AHAHAHA! CAN'T BREATHE AND DON'T CARE! COME ON!
KILL ME THEN! SEE WHAT HAPPENS!
HEART'S GOING TO EXPLODE! LETS GOOO!
I'M STILL HERE, YOU FUCKING MONSTERS!
COME AND TAKE IT!
FUCK YOU!!!!
TAKE ME ON FUCKERS!
I AIN'T GOING DOWN THAT EASILY NOW!
I'M HAVING SUCH A JOYRIDE YOU FUCKS!
psychology_trio_spiteful_respite: Sitting in the dirt feeling cozy. Pathetic.
A warm second before the slaughter. Fantastic.
I hate that this feels good. It changes nothing.
A pleasant moment in hell. Big whoop.
I'm having the time of my life... not really.
psychology_trio_feral_cornered: STOP FAILING! STOP CLICKING! SHUT UP!
I'LL BASH YOUR SKULL IN IF YOU COME CLOSER!
EVERYTHING IS GOING WRONG AT ONCE!
psychology_grounding_plushie: Just... hold onto it. It's soft.
Focus on the fluff. I'm okay. I'm here.
Nhhh... Don't let me go please...
psychology_grounding_meds: Just let the fog roll in.
Ohhh boy. Yep. Yeah. Thaaaat's better...
psychology_memory_meal: I remember having that food... that was really nice.
...At least I had something decent to eat back there.
Remember that meal? Felt normal for a minute.
Good food. Wish I had more of it.
Just thinking about that meal... Yummy...
I wish I could go back and just keep eating... that was nice.
Mmmm... If only I could find more.
psychology_meal_monotony: I'm so sick of eating this.
Tastes like nothing now. I want real food...
If I have to chew on another one of these...
Can I eat literally anything else?
psychology_starvation_relief: I thought I was actually going to starve back there...
That hollow ache is finally gone.
Haven't felt that full in forever.
psychology_eat_experimentflesh: Oh god... what did I just eat?
I feel sick. Sick to my stomach.
Please don't let that be who I think it was...
psychology_eat_organs: It burst in my mouth... fuck.
psychology_eat_dogfood: Eating out of a can like a dog...
Degrading... but I need the calories.
Smells like wet cardboard and ash.
psychology_crystal_soothe: The humming... it's kind of calming.
The shard feels warm in my pocket.
Quiet... just breathe with the pulse.
psychology_crystal_dissonance: It's vibrating so hard it hurts to hold...
The hum feels cold. It's not helping at all.
Stop buzzing... you can't fix this.
It feels like ice against my chest.
psychology_crystal_overload: It cracked... even the crystal couldn't take it.
Shattered into dust in my hands.
psychology_memory_injury_minor: Feet still throb a bit from landing rough.
...Bruised up, but it could've been a lot worse.
Just a scrape. Still aches though.
That one sure roughed me a little.
psychology_memory_injury: I still ache where I got mangled.
Can't shake the memory of getting torn open...
...That pain... almost didn't make it out.
Still stings when I move wrong.
I'm suprised I got out of that one.
Maybe I did learn a thing or two...
psychology_memory_escape: Managed to dodge that trap... still got some reflexes left.
Got away by the skin of my teeth back there.
...Could've been shreds. Glad I reacted in time.
Well now I know what to avoid.
I'm still amazed I got by.
psychology_memory_horror_single: Why did they have to die like that?
That first body, it still sticks with me.
It was so much worse than when they just disappeared in the lab.
How did they even die like that...?
psychology_memory_horror_multiple: Am I just waiting for my turn to join the dead?
I think the word we learned for this kind of place is genocide...
psychology_memory_horror: That... they vanished into thin air. Was anyone even there?
I could've sworn I saw someone standing...
It was all smoke and shadows...
That thing looming over me while I couldn't move... what was it?
Felt something heavy pressing down on my chest in the dark.
Can't shake the feeling that something watched me while I slept.
Waking up frozen like that... I thought I was already dead.
I saw something standing in the dark. Then it just dissolved.
My own head is turning against me down here.
Something is wrong with this place. Deeply wrong.
psychology_unchipped_somatic_anxiety: Too fast... can't catch my breath.
...Chest is tight. Need to calm down.
psychology_somatic_hypothermia: I'd l-love a human's c-c-coat right now... they looked warm.
psychology_somatic_hypovolemia: ...Need to stop the bleeding... getting so weak.
psychology_unchipped_inspection_low_vale: Body feels like lead. Can barely keep moving.
Why am I even trying? Everything feels cold.
I'm exhausted. I don't know how much longer I can keep going.
psychology_unchipped_inspection_high_aro: Chest feels tight... heart won't stop pounding against my ribs.
Hands won't stop shaking... need to breathe.
Everything's moving too fast. Can't steady myself.
I can't calm down. Something feels terribly wrong.
psychology_unchipped_inspection_low_agen: I'm trapped. Nothing I can do.
Out of my hands. Completely out of my hands.
What was I even supposed to do coming here?
Can the scientists hear me? I need some instructions...!
psychology_unchipped_inspection_calm: Breathing is steady. One step at a time.
I'm alright. Just keep doing what I know.
psychology_memory_trade: Good to speak with someone who didn't try to kill me.
...At least someone else is alive down here.
Felt nice doing a bit of business.
Wonder how that person back there is doing?
psychology_memory_craft_good: Put that together properly. Still useful.
Made something that works. That's something.
psychology_memory_craft_bad: What a mess that craft was...
psychology_memory_lab_calm: Faint memory of the holding cell... humming softly.
The light through the slit before the guards came by.
I remember the count-off before lockup. Just a number.
The room smelled like cold concrete. Still and quiet.
The laboratory was a strange place, they did so many tests.
I wonder how many of us were in the kennels, it was always changing.
Some of the humans were okay, I guess.
I wonder how my friends are doing.
Wish they let me keep my things.
The humans were so weird. Why did they look like that?
psychology_memory_lab_unsettling: Still remember the cold floor in that holding cell...
They dragged me out before I could even stand on my own.
The blinding flash of the neural scan... still burns behind my eyes.
Someone was shouting through the cell door before they locked it.
Cold metal bench. Restraints clicking shut. I can't shake that feeling.
I hated how often the other sawians just vanished.
So many of the humans were just mean to us...
psychology_memory_general_positive: Things could be worse. I've had worse days.
Still breathing. That counts for something.
It's just another test to pass.
psychology_memory_general_negative: Everything just falls apart down here.
Just one bad thing after another.
psychology_dissociative_stare: Why do you keep pushing?
...There's nothing left down here.
...So tired. Just so tired.
What are you looking at?
...Does any of this matter to you?
...Are you just watching me die?
Is someone on the other side of this?
...Can you even hear me?
Glass between us. Nothing else.
Are you pulling the strings?
It's all hollow.
Stop staring.
...Just looking right through me.
Haven't you had enough?
What are you?
You. Looking at me. Watching me. What are you?
Don't you have anything better to do?
What about you? What are you hiding from?
You know this won't make any of your problems go away.
How many times have we been here before?
Is this how you treat everyone you watch over?
Just a bunch of shapes and noise on a flat piece of plastic.
No. It's okay. I understand. I would do the same to you.
Sooner or later you have to get back to your life. You're just like me.
psychology_futile_refusal: Why bother? It won't save us.
I can't. I just can't do it.
When can I build something that lets me leave?
Oh great, more shit to carry.
psychology_medical_resigned_profound: Get fixed so I can get hurt again, and again
Everything just hurts down here anyway...
psychology_item_lost_traded: Gave away half my gear for that, and it's gone.
Are you kidding me? I literally just traded for it.
psychology_item_recovered_intact: Got some dirt on it, but it's fine.
Thought it was gone for good.
psychology_item_recovered_damaged: What is this shit all over it?
I can... Probably salvage it. Maybe.
psychology_hostile_killed: Eugh... Gross. It's all over me now.
Gonna have to do more than that.
Ew ew ew ew. Never again.
psychology_clone_killed: No... Nonono! Please wake up... I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
psychology_trader_killed: ...Didn't have to be like this.
...No going back now.
Why did I do that? Why?
It's not my fault... It's... Oh god...
What have I done? Oh god, no, please...
I'm... Wait. No, no no no, I'm sorry...
N-no, wait, no, please wake up-!
Are you okay-? Oh god, no, what did I just do?
Wait... No! Wake up, wake up, please, say something-!
psychology_corpse_smashed: Fuck, it gave under my boots...
Gross... it's all over my legs.
psychology_last_stand_resilient: HAH... HAH...! I was dead... I WAS DEAD!
WHO WAS LAUGHING?! WHO THE FUCK WAS LAUGHING AT ME?!
Ghhk! My heart- it stopped! It just started again?!
WHAT WAS THAT?! I was gone! I felt everything shut down!
Hhh... hhh... Oh God, why am I still here?! What just pulled me back?!
NO NO NO! Don't let me see that darkness again! Please!
I heard laughter in my head... someone was laughing... what the fuck is happening?!
psychology_last_stand_resigned: Why... why didn't you let me go?!
Hhhk... I was almost out... why am I back in this body?!
Stop laughing at me! JUST LET ME DIE!
No... no... I felt it ending... why did my heart start again?!
Who was that laughing... God, please just make it stop...
psychology_borrowed_time_fading: It's fading... the adrenaline's running out...
Hhh... hands are shaking again... not much time left...
Heart's slowing down... I have to fix this before it runs out!
No, don't crash now... keep moving... KEEP MOVING!
psychology_solitary_mutter: Check the pack, check the footing. One step at a time.
psychology_solitary_schizoid: Did you hear that? Shh. Don't answer.
They know I'm here. I know they do.
I see you watching. Back off.
They're talking about me again. I can hear them.
Don't listen to them. They want me to listen.
psychology_trap_calm_recognition: I know that sound. Stay clear.
I've seen this before. Give it some room.
That's a trap. Don't get too close.
Something's wrong here. Keep your distance.
I've learned what happens when you ignore that.
I recognize the warning signs... Move, quietly.
psychology_trap_repanic: I've been here before. Get away from it!
Get back! Get the hell back!
I know what comes next. Run!
No, no, no. I can't do this again!
psychology_flashlight_died_joyous: Great. Just great. Come on, don't do this to me now...
Okay, not funny. Anyone got a spare cell?!
Ah, wonderful. Flying blind in a cave. What could go wrong?
Work, you little bulb! I was actually in a good mood!
...And the light dies. Because of course it does.
Aw, come on... It just had to happen now.
psychology_flashlight_died_angry: Are you kidding me?! Piece of junk! Work, damn it!
Die now?! Of all the goddamn times!
Tch! Useless piece of scrap! *shakes flashlight furiously*
Fucking dead battery! You've got to be shitting me!
Work! *bangs against palm* Don't make me smash you into the wall!
Fucking piece of shit, work damn it!
psychology_flashlight_died_sorrow: Of course. Leave me in the dark too. Why wouldn't you...
I knew it would fail. Everything down here fails.
...Can't even have a little light. Just swallow me whole, then.
Darkness. Back where I belong, I guess.
Well, that was a good run.
psychology_flashlight_died_neutral: Tch. Dead battery. Pitch black. Have to move by feel.
Light's out. Just gotta check your sorroundings more carefully now.
Now it's dark... better be careful now.
psychology_darkness_wandering: Did something just move out there? Keep moving...
Eyes straining... can't see five feet ahead.
Every shadow feels like it's creeping closer...
Need a torch or a campfire... anything with a flame.
Just keep one hand on the rock. Don't lose your balance.
Sounded like breathing... No, just the wind through the cracks.
*whistling*
psychology_trap_sonar_angry: Is that all you've got?! Ears are ringing, piece of scrap!
Agh! Rattled my teeth, you bastard!
Cheap sonic wave! Try harder next time!
Ear-piercing piece of shit! I'll dismantle you!
AAAAOWWWW!!! FUCK! FUCK YOU TOO, ASSHOLE!
I CAN SCREAM LOUDER THAN YOU CAN!
psychology_trap_sonar_joyous_hit: Guh! My head... that vibrated my entire skull! Not good!
Whoa! Felt that in my teeth! That was way too close!
Ow, ow, ow! Okay, brain definitely rattled on that one!
Agh! My ears! Still standing, though!
psychology_trap_sonar_sorrow_hit: Can't even think... just endless ringing...
Head splitting open... why bother dodging...
Everything vibrates... can't even hear my own breathing...
Just let the wave crush my skull next time.
psychology_trap_sonar_neutral_miss: That wave missed. Good. Keep moving.
That was close. Let's not find out how close.
Whatever that was, I'm staying away from it.
psychology_trap_turret_joyous_hit: Agh! Damn it... I was feeling good for once! That stung!
Ow! Okay, lesson learned. Don't celebrate early!
Grazed me! Son of a bitch nearly had me!
psychology_trap_turret_angry_hit: You mechanical bastard! I'll tear you apart!
Keep shooting, machine! See who gives out first!
Rrrgh! You hit me?! I'll tear you apart!
psychology_trap_turret_sorrow_hit: Bleeding again... of course it found me.
Just put another hole in me, why don't you...
More blood. What else is new.
psychology_trap_beartrap_sorrow_hit: Of course. A bear trap. Why wouldn't it be my <limb>...
Chewed right through my <limb>... just leave me here.
Clamped down to the bone. Figures.
psychology_trap_beartrap_angry_hit: Rrrgh! Filthy rusted teeth! Get off my <limb>!
Damn jaw snapped right into the bone! Rrrgh!
psychology_trap_beartrap_joyous_freed: Ha! Teeth didn't take the whole <limb>! We're still walking!
Out of the jaws! Still got both feet!
Pried loose! Flesh tore, but I'm still mobile!
psychology_trap_mine_tactical: That was a mine. Stay away from there.
Something just exploded. Watch where you step.
That could've been a lot worse. Keep your distance.
psychology_trap_mine_angry_miss: Missed me, you piece of rust! Nice try!
Triggered too early, you piece of junk! Ha!
Just gravel and smoke! Not good enough!
psychology_mp_peer_trap_worry: Comrade hit! Watch the perimeter, get them clear!
Hang on! I see the trap, don't move!
Watch your footing! Trap in the sector!
psychology_mp_peer_trap_grief: NO! God, they got shredded... Why didn't I see it?!
They're gone... torn apart in a second...
Not like this... God, not like this...
Nothing left of them... Damn this cave!
psychology_mp_peer_saved: Thank god... you made it through that.
Hang in there. We're still breathing.
You're patched up. Stay close, we move together.
Got you back on your feet. Keep your eyes open.
psychology_lab_sensory_detached: ...Smells like the damp air from the holding blocks.
...Heard that hum through the heavy cell door once.
...Sterile hiss. Reminds me of the pre-transfer prep.
Cold air. Like stepping onto the cell block floor.
...Smells like the disinfectant wash back then.
...Fluorescent buzz. Just like the examination room.
...Tiles on the floor. Always freezing under bare feet.
...White coats talking outside the observation slot.
psychology_lab_sensory_dread: ...That smell. That's the sterilant from the detention wing.
...I know that frequency. The guards used that before the sweep.
Whatever happens. Don't lock me back in that cell. Please.
...Restraints clicking. Can still feel the straps.
I hope that stuff they poked me with is all worked out by now.
psychology_recovery_minor: I'll be good as new soon.
psychology_recovery_major: As long as I don't get another of those.
I can barely believe I survived that.
psychology_suicide_defiant_rage: FUCK YOU! I'M NOT GIVING UP!
NOT BY MY OWN HAND! DIE INSTEAD!
psychology_suicide_aborted: What am I doing, what am I doing...?
psychology_sensory_break: ...Leave me in the dark. Just five minutes.
I can't look at this anymore.
...Close my eyes and pretend none of this is here.
psychology_claw_eye_out: FUCK! FUCK! MY EYE! WHAT DID I DO?!
AAGH! NO NO NO! MY EYE! OH GOD!
I TORE IT OUT! GOD, I TORE IT OUT!
AAGHH! CAN'T SEE! STOP THE BLEEDING!
psychology_item_lost_joyous: Maybe I'll find something better below.
Maybe I'll find it down a bit further?
psychology_item_lost_melancholic: Of fucking course. Another thing lost.
Why do I even bother carrying anything?
I probably needed that one too.
Just when it couldn't have gotten worse.
psychology_item_lost_paranoid: Where is it?! I had it right here!
No, no, no...! Who kicked it away?!
The humans made me drop it, I just know it.
It had to have pulled itself away, they're testing me!
psychology_craft_apathetic: Finished. Still trapped in this hole.
Back to crafting like a drone.
psychology_craft_frustrated: Why can't anything just be easy to get?

psychology_craft_triumphant: Done. One less thing to worry about.

One step closer to surviving this cave.
psychology_craft_manic: I can't wait to make another!
Ooh, I'll be out of here in no time.
psychology_injury_defiant: Bandage it later. Not done yet.

psychology_injury_resigned: I guess I should bandage it up.

psychology_injury_spiteful: Try that again, see what happens!

You're gonna pay for that one.
psychology_injury_terrified: Please, someone, I need help, fast.!
I need to do something before it gets worse!
psychology_medical_pragmatic: Set straight. It'll fix up okay.
Tied off. It'll hold for now.
psychology_weapon_jam_panic: Clear it, clear it, come on!
Guns aren't supposed to do that!
psychology_weapon_jam_rage: Clear it, you piece of shit!
psychology_weapon_empty_despair: ...Dry. Might as well throw the damn thing.

moodle.panickingdsc: Heart racing and breath catching. Shaking too hard to stay steady.
moodle.panicking1dsc: Hands won't stop twitching. Heart is beating way too fast.
moodle.panicking2dsc: Chest feels tight and breathing is ragged. Hard to focus on what's in front of you.
moodle.panicking3dsc: Dread taking over. Tremors making fingers slip and vision tunneling.
moodle.panicking4dsc: Complete panic. You can't think straight or keep your hands steady.
moodle.panicking_veterandsc: Pulse hammering in your ears. Fighting to keep the tremor in check.
moodle.flashbackdsc: Sudden sounds dragging up bad memories.
moodle.flashback1dsc: Phantom clicks and hums lingering in your ears.
moodle.flashback2dsc: Sudden noises keep reminding you of past close calls.
moodle.flashback3dsc: Every sound feels like a trap or gunshot about to go off.
moodle.flashback4dsc: Overwhelmed by sounds that aren't there. Feels like you're right back in it.
moodle.flashback_veterandsc: Phantom noises creeping in. You know what it is, but it still sets your teeth on edge.
moodle.frustrateddsc: Nothing is working out. It's grating on your nerves.
moodle.frustrated1dsc: Every little thing is snagging and getting in the way.
moodle.frustrated2dsc: Jittery and impatient. Nothing seems to be going smoothly.
moodle.frustrated3dsc: Furious and frazzled. You feel like every minor inconvenice is a personal attack.
moodle.frustrated_veterandsc: One mistake after another. One misstep after another. One setback after another. This is starting to piss you off.
moodle.melancholicdsc: Weary and worn thin. Everything feels like too much effort.
moodle.melancholic1dsc: Heavy limbs and low energy. Hard to get motivated.
moodle.melancholic2dsc: A deep, quiet fatigue. Moving feels like wading through sludge.
moodle.melancholic3dsc: Too tired to care. Wondering why you're even bothering.
moodle.melancholic4dsc: Completely spent. The cave feels cold, dark, and endless, taking it's toll on you.
moodle.melancholic_veterandsc: Bone-tired, but moving forward anyway just out of spite.
moodle.resilient1dsc: Breath under control. Hands are steady.
moodle.resilient2dsc: Locked in and moving with purpose. Ready for whatever comes next.
moodle.resilient3dsc: Total focus. Shrugging off the pressure and getting things done.
moodle.resilient_veterandsc: You've lived through worse. You're calm, and deliberate.

ui.psychology_cond_depression_desc: Crushing sorrow and a feeling that nothing matters. Hard to find relief in anything.
ui.psychology_cond_learned_helplessness_des: Convinced that nothing you do will change anything. Takes real progress to break out.
ui.psychology_cond_hypervigilance_desc: Jumpy and constantly on guard, burning through nervous energy.
ui.psychology_cond_agitation_desc: Restless, irritable energy driven by high stress and constant frustration.
ui.psychology_cond_catatonia_desc: Completely frozen under overwhelming stress; barely moving or speaking.
ui.psychology_cond_anhedonia_desc: Completely numb. Nothing feels good or satisfying.
ui.psychology_cond_paranoia_desc: Convinced everything and everyone around you is an immediate threat.
ui.psychology_cond_delirium_desc: Feverish and disoriented from severe pain and bodily trauma.
ui.psychology_cond_sensory_overload_desc: Every noise and flash of light feels loud, painful, and overwhelming.
ui.psychology_cond_flow_desc: Completely locked in. Smooth rhythm and sharp execution.
ui.psychology_cond_grounded_desc: Settled down and calm, anchored by rest and warmth.
ui.psychology_cond_catharsis_desc: A sudden flood of relief after surviving something that should have killed you.
ui.psychology_cond_euphoria_desc: A rush of adrenaline and optimism blunting pain and raising confidence.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_valence_severe_pos: • Riding an intense wave of optimism.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_arousal_high: • Jumpy and on edge, scanning every shadow.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_agency_steady: • Keeping a steady grip on the situation.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_agency_low: • Feeling out of depth and losing grip.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_social_isolated: • Starting to feel the heavy weight of isolation.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_pred_disoriented: • Getting turned around in these caves.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_panic_siege: • In full panic: breathing fast, hands shaking.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_corpse_calloused: • Used to dead bodies; barely registers them.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_corpse_repulsed: • Sickened by the stench and presence of the dead.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_trap_crawling: • Hair standing on end from nearby traps.
ui.psychology_dossier_item_desc: Preliminary neuro-psychiatric assessment document and telemetry baseline. Drag to center to examine.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_basal: Baseline autonomic and somatic stability within standard calibration parameters.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_masochist: Inverted nociceptive response; paradoxically stabilized by somatic injury.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_stoic_vanguard: High somatic pain tolerance coupled with rapid cognitive stress recovery.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_acute_reactive: Heightened autonomic arousal and acute pain sensitivity under physical threat.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_combative: Elevated defensive arousal; converts perceived vulnerability into combative action.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_passive: Marked passivity in conflict scenarios; low autonomic threat response.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_blunted_pain: Blunted pain conduction; heightened physical endurance during trauma.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_acute_pain: Sensory-sensitive pain conduction; requires careful somatic management.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_resilient: Rapid cognitive recalibration and sustained agency retention following crises.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_fragile: Vulnerable stress threshold; susceptible to cognitive degradation during sustained peril.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_high_strung: Elevated startle reflex and sympathetic arousal reactivity.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_cold_blooded: Attenuated autonomic response; maintains steady heart rate under acute stress.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_balanced: Balanced psychological baseline across standard behavioral and autonomic vectors.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_neurotic: Severe autonomic volatility; heightened sympathetic hyperventilation and panic cascading under stress.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_optimist: Persistent affective resilience; maintains positive valence baseline and resists existential demoralization.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_pessimist: Anticipatory disaster bias; suppressed baseline mood but heightened cognitive stability when catastrophes occur.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_fatalist: Resigned fatalistic outlook; blunted panic response coupled with diminished individual agency.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_stoic_philo: Suppressed sympathetic reactivity; sustains low baseline arousal and resists affective panic.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_nihilist: Existential detachment; immune to corpse horror and clone copy crises, with blunted intrinsic motivation.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_cynic: Defensive interpersonal cynicism; impervious to trader deception shock and social betrayal.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_attachment: Socially dependent; relies heavily on companionship and suffers acute loneliness when isolated.
ui.mindcleandsc: A 60ml pill bottle. Prepared with 45ml of mindclean and 15ml of opium to ease acute trauma and soothe distress.
ui.mindclean_liquiddsc: Specially synthesized palliative neuro-scrub engineered as a softer alternative to a total mindwipe. Selectively scrubs acute traumatic memory engrams and dampens hyper-aroused affective distress while preserving identity, motor faculties, and baseline survival conditioning. Warning: Due to incomplete receptor targeting, erratic side effects include transient retrograde amnesia of benign experiences, pleasant memory erasure, and disinhibition. Administer with caution.
ui.mindclean_alert_sideeffect: Brain fog intensifies... pleasant thoughts slip away.
ui.mindwipe_moodle_stage0_desc: Numbness spreading. Thoughts are slipping away.
ui.mindwipe_moodle_stage1_desc: Severe neural spasms. Thoughts are fragmenting.
